data.name: Auto Shrooms
data.detailed_description:
Grow, harvest, and command your troop of tiny mushrooms in this auto battler where you have to grow your units. Master the lifecycle of your Sporelings to create specialised units. Adapt to hostile alien worlds by changing your formation, equipment, and traits. All biomass will be assimilated.

Battle

Watch your carefully grown army fight in intense but cute fungal warfare.

Grow

Master the lifecycle of the Sporelings to navigate power and time tradeoffs. Do you leave a unit growing so that it will become more powerful at the cost of not using it in the upcoming battle? Or do you harvest it now because you're short on fire power?

Adapt

Watch the battles unfold, see what worked and what didn't.

Weapons, specialised units, fertilisers, tweaking your formation, you will have multiple tools at your disposal to handle upcoming battles in the way you like best.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-Core 2.0 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: ntel HD Graphics 4000 / AMD Radeon Vega 8 (OpenGL 3.3 / Vulkan support)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-Core 2.5 GHz+ (Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 3 or better)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850 or better
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or Apple Silicon (M1)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal / OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey) or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) / Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible integrated or dedicated GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
